segments.sn28.4:1.2: Addasā kho āyasmā ānando … pe …“vippasannāni kho te, āvuso sāriputta, indriyāni;
segments.sn28.4:2.1: “Idhāhaṃ, āvuso, sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
segments.sn28.4:2.2: Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, na evaṃ hoti –
segments.sn28.4:2.3: ‘ahaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmī’ti vā ‘ahaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpanno’ti vā ‘ahaṃ catutthā jhānā vuṭṭhito’ti vā”ti.
segments.sn28.4:2.4: “Tathā hi panāyasmato sāriputtassa dīgharattaṃ ahaṅkāramamaṅkāramānānusayā susamūhatā.
segments.sn28.4:2.5: Tasmā āyasmato sāriputtassa na evaṃ hoti –
segments.sn28.4:2.6: ‘ahaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmī’ti vā ‘ahaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpanno’ti vā ‘ahaṃ catutthā jhānā vuṭṭhito’ti vā”ti.
